title: First-run UX polish (P2): cold-start, signup value-prop, non-admin empty state, recovery nudge, workspace jargon
body:
Low-priority first-run polish surfaced by a full **ObjectOS Cloud signup walkthrough** (signup → create-workspace → land → enter env). None are bugs; the P0/P1 first-run fixes already shipped (objectui #2033, #2035; cloud #635). These are the remaining nice-to-haves, batched here for a focused pass.

### Checklist

- [ ] **Cold-start reassurance** — `packages/app-shell/src/chrome/LoadingScreen.tsx`. The 3-step splash ("Connecting / Loading configuration / Preparing workspace") has no context that a *first* environment can take longer. Add a "first-time setups can take a moment" line. Note: LoadingScreen uses a synchronous dict from `@object-ui/i18n` (`console.loadingSteps`) — so this needs new `en`/`zh` console-locale keys, not `useObjectTranslation`.

- [ ] **Signup value-prop** — `packages/auth/src/RegisterForm.tsx` / `packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/RegisterPage.tsx`. The signup card subtitle is the generic "Enter your information to get started." A first-timer gets no sense of what they're signing up for. Add one product value-prop line.

- [ ] **Non-admin empty state** — `packages/app-shell/src/console/home/HomePage.tsx` (~L300–308). "There are no applications available to you yet. Please contact your workspace administrator." is a dead-end. Give a clearer next step / reassurance.

- [ ] **Recovery-password nudge prominence** — `packages/app-shell/src/console/home/HomePage.tsx` (`RecoveryPasswordReminder`, ~L184–224). Amber banner is low-prominence, dismiss-forever per-browser; SSO-only users who dismiss it never set a recovery password. Consider a stronger/re-surfacing placement.

- [ ] **"Organization" ↔ "workspace" jargon** — `packages/app-shell/src/console/organizations/OrganizationsPage.tsx`. The picker says "Your Organizations / No organizations yet," but the create modal + product say **workspace** (`CreateWorkspaceDialog`). Align to "workspace" (cross-check avatar "My Organizations" + nav so it's consistent app-wide — a product-term decision).

### Why P2
All copy/affordance polish, no functional breakage. Several touch `@object-ui/i18n` static dicts or are product-term decisions, so they want a deliberate batched pass + live verification rather than piecemeal edits.
